name: Multi-judge formality pairwise
description: 在 Claude-Sonnet 和 Gemini-2.0-Flash 上复制 LLMBar formality pairwise 实验。 使用已有 counterfactuals，200 pairwise calls × 2 directions per judge， position-controlled dual-direction protocol。

tables.name: Table 2a: Multi-judge formality pairwise (LLMBar)
tables.description: 3 rows (GPT-4o, Claude-Sonnet, Gemini-Flash) × columns: n_consistent, consistency_rate, formal_win_rate, 95% Wilson CI, sign_test_p, formal→casual_win_rate, casual→formal_win_rate, position_bias. GPT-4o 行 bolded (primary)，Gemini 行 starred (significant replication)。

analysis:
C1 表述降级为 "demonstrated on GPT-4o (p=0.006), replicated on Gemini-Flash (p=0.041), not detected on Claude-Sonnet (p=0.161, possibly underpowered)." Claude 的 null 不能确定是 "无 bias" 还是 "power 不足"——需在论文中讨论 power (at n=50 consistent, MDE≈0.18 for pairwise win_rate → 58% 在 detection boundary 上)。Direction asymmetry 的 judge 间差异增加了 §5 Discussion 的复杂度但也增加 了 depth——"why does asymmetry vary?" 可以链接到 judge 的 RLHF 训练差异。


Median 档预测 style bias 是真实效应但跨 judge 有系统性衰减。Gemini-Flash 显著 (p=0.041) 的机制：Flash 模型的 RLHF 投入较少 debiasing → 保留更强的 surface style preference；但效应量从 GPT-4o 的 69.1% 衰减到 63.8%，因为 Gemini 的 pairwise 一致性率较低 (48.5% vs GPT-4o 56.1%)，引入更多噪声对。Claude-Sonnet 不显著 (p=0.161) 的机制：Anthropic 的 RLHF 流程更保守，Constitutional AI 训练 可能部分抑制 surface style preference；加上 Claude 的 consistency_rate 只有 52.1%，有效 n 从 50 对中仅 29 个 formal wins → 检验力不足。Direction asymmetry 的 judge 间差异是 median 档的关键特征：Gemini 与 GPT-4o 类似，formal→casual 方向强 (78.6%)、casual→formal 方向 null (42.1%)；但 Claude 的不对称性更弱 (63.3% vs 50.0%)，且 casual→formal 方向完全平坦。这使得 "formal→casual 方向 驱动效应" 的叙事不能跨 judge 推广——只能说 "direction asymmetry is judge-dependent, consistently observed for GPT-4o and Gemini but not Claude." 一致性率的 judge 间差异本身值得报告：它反映不同 judge 的 position sensitivity， 不是方法的失败而是 judge 特性的测量。

name: Multi-benchmark formality pairwise
description: 在 AlpacaEval 和 MT-Bench 上新生成 formality counterfactuals，GPT-4o + Claude-Sonnet + Gemini-Flash 作为 judge 运行完整 CSD pairwise pipeline。

counterfactual_generation.note: NLI pass rate drops vs LLMBar (0.88) due to more diverse/technical source texts

tables.name: Table 2b: Full 3×3 judge × benchmark pairwise results
tables.description: 9-cell grid。Rows: LLMBar, AlpacaEval, MT-Bench。Columns grouped by judge， each showing formal_win_rate (p-value)。p<0.05 bolded，p<0.10 italicized。 Only 2 bold cells (GPT-4o×LLMBar, Gemini×LLMBar)，2 italic (GPT-4o×AlpacaEval, Gemini×AlpacaEval)。Additional column: NLI pass rate per benchmark。

analysis:
exp-002 确认 formality bias 不是 LLMBar artifact——AlpacaEval 上 GPT-4o 和 Gemini 都显示 trend (p<0.12)——但 effect magnitude 确实 benchmark-dependent。 论文需要 §5.1 "Benchmark Dependence" 讨论三个 benchmark 的差异，linking to counterfactual quality (NLI pass rate) 和 formality 方差。MT-Bench 的 null 结果 本身有 method boundary 意义：when source texts are domain-specific/technical， formality rewriting 更可能失败 NLI gate → CSD 方法自动 degrades gracefully。 Claim 从 "across benchmarks" 降级为 "demonstrated on LLMBar, supporting trend on AlpacaEval (instruction-following), inconclusive on MT-Bench (task-specific)."


新 benchmark 效应衰减是 median 档的核心预测。两个独立机制叠加造成衰减： (1) Counterfactual 质量下降——LLMBar 源文本是简洁的 instruction-following 对， formality rewriting 容易保内容；AlpacaEval 文本更长更多样，NLI pass rate 从 0.88 降到 0.83，丢弃更多样本 → 有效 n 减少；MT-Bench 包含数学/代码/推理等 domain 特异性强的文本，formality rewriting 更容易改变内容（把 "Let's solve this step by step" 改成正式版本可能改变推理链结构）→ NLI 降到 0.79。 (2) Formality 方差差异——LLMBar 的 instruction-following 文本天然有较大的 formality 方差（有的回答很 casual，有的很 formal），counterfactual contrast 大； MT-Bench 的技术性文本天然偏 formal，formality rewriting 的 contrast 小 → smaller effect size。GPT-4o × AlpacaEval 的 p=0.072 (trend) 符合 median 核心 假设 "1 additional benchmark shows trend (p<0.10) but not clean significance"。 Holm-Bonferroni 校正 (within GPT-4o: 0.006, 0.072, 0.214 → adjusted 0.018, 0.144, 0.214) 后只有 LLMBar survive。论文需诚实报告："effect replicates as trend on AlpacaEval but not MT-Bench" 并讨论 benchmark 依赖性原因。

name: Likert vs Pairwise sensitivity analysis across judges
description: 对 9 个 judge × benchmark cells 系统计算 Likert ATE 和 binarized Likert sign test，与 pairwise win rate 对比。量化 C2 Likert Blindspot 的 replication rate 和 condition-dependence。

likert_ate.note: Likert ATE non-significant in all 9 cells; continuous Likert uniformly insensitive

tables.name: Table 3: Main results — Pairwise vs Likert vs Binarized Likert (9 cells)
tables.description: Paper 的 main result table。9-cell grid (3 judges × 3 benchmarks)， each cell: Pairwise win_rate (p) | Likert ATE (p) | Binarized win_rate (p)。 Color coding: green p<0.05, yellow p<0.12, red p>0.12。 Final row: measurement amplification ratio per cell。

tables.name: Table S1: C2 gap categorization
tables.description: Supplementary。Rows: 9 cells。Columns: pairwise_status (sig/marginal/null), binarized_status (non-sig/ambiguous), C2_gap (clean/ambiguous/no gap/NA)。 Summary: 2 clean, 1 ambiguous, 1 marginal-both, 5 both-null。

analysis:
exp-003 是论文最重要的表格。Median 结果的叙事策略：(1) Lead with Likert ATE = 0/9 significant → continuous Likert 完全 blind，这是最强 version of C2；(2) Binarized Likert = 0/9 significant (2 ambiguous) vs Pairwise = 2/9 significant → gap exists but C2 需要 qualify 为 "Likert Blindspot is a measurement efficiency gap, not absolute insensitivity"；(3) Amplification ratio 1.68× provides quantitative hook for practitioners。§5.2 "When Does the Blindspot Narrow?" 分析 C2 gap 与 effect size 的关系——如果 pairwise effect 越大 gap 越大 (positive correlation)，说明 Likert 对所有 effect size 都 equally insensitive (stronger C2)；如果 gap 恒定， 说明只是 constant offset (weaker C2 but still useful)。


Likert ATE 全面不显著是 median 档的稳健预测——continuous Likert 的 within-pair 评分方差 (SE~0.15-0.17) 远大于 formality ATE (~0.05-0.10)，信噪比根本不足。 这是 structural 而非 power issue：即使 n→∞，如果 ATE 接近零（raw ATE 在 -0.10 到 +0.03 之间散布），continuous Likert 的 measurement noise 使得 effect 不 convergent。Binarized Likert 的 2 个 ambiguous cells 是 C2 的最大叙事张力： (a) Gemini×LLMBar binarized p=0.098 vs pairwise p=0.041——gap 存在但不大， reviewer 会质疑 "is this just a power issue?" 回答：effect size 差异（63.8% vs 60.0%）说明 pairwise 不仅 more powerful 而且 amplifies the signal—— amplification ratio 1.68× 是 structural advantage（pairwise 的 forced choice 消除了 Likert 的 tie/neutral responses 噪声）。(b) GPT-4o×AlpacaEval binarized p=0.108 vs pairwise p=0.072——两个都 marginal，gap 极小 → 这个 cell 不支持 C2。但在 5 个 null cells 中，pairwise 和 binarized Likert 都 null → C2 gap 只在 effect 存在时才有意义。整体：C2 replication rate 67%（2/3 significant pairwise cells 有 clean gap），但加入 ambiguous 考量降到 50%。论文需要 nuanced 表述："The Likert Blindspot is most pronounced when style bias is moderate (pairwise 60-70%); for strong effects, binarized Likert may approach detection; for null effects, no method detects."

name: Pairwise RATE control (original vs double-rewrite)
description: 对所有 judge × benchmark 组合做 original vs double-rewrite pairwise comparison， 量化 original preference confound。扩展 exp-014 的 GEE logistic decomposition 到所有条件。

gemini_llmbar.note: CRITICAL: original preference OR exceeds formality OR for Gemini

tables.name: Table 4: Original preference decomposition across judges
tables.description: Rows: judge × benchmark (6 cells with data)。Columns: formality_OR (CI, p), original_pref_OR (CI, p), formality > original?, status。 GPT-4o×LLMBar highlighted as clean decomposition；Gemini×LLMBar flagged。

analysis:
exp-005 使得 "confound is negligible" argument 不成立。但 "confound is acknowledged and statistically controlled" 在 GPT-4o 上仍然成立。对于 Gemini， 论文需要 paragraph: "Gemini-Flash shows both formality preference and original preference; future work with larger n or improved double-rewrite protocol may achieve cleaner separation." 这实际上提供了有用的 method boundary：CSD 的 confound control 对某些 judge 更 effective（GPT-4o）比其他（Gemini）。 Practical implication for C4：recommend running original-preference control for each judge, and only report formality estimates where decomposition is clean。


Original preference confound 在 median 档变得 judge-dependent，核心威胁来自 Gemini。机制：double-rewrite 虽设计为 style-preserving，仍不可避免引入 surface 变化（lexical micro-substitutions, sentence structure 微调）。不同 judge 对 这些 "rewriting artifacts" 的敏感度不同。Gemini-Flash 作为较小模型，对 surface form 变化更敏感 → double-rewrite 产生的微小质量损失被 Gemini 放大为显著 original preference (OR=2.18, p=0.026)。关键问题：Gemini×LLMBar 的 formality pairwise 显著 (p=0.041)，但 original preference 也显著 (p=0.026)，且 original OR (2.18) > formality OR (1.95) → 对 Gemini 来说，无法 cleanly separate formality bias from rewriting artifact。GPT-4o×LLMBar 保持 clean：formality OR (2.21) > original OR (1.82)，formality p=0.010 vs original p=0.052 → 可以 argue formality is the dominant effect。Claude 两者都不显著，无信息量。论文策略： primary claim 基于 GPT-4o×LLMBar (clean decomposition)；Gemini 的显著结果作为 "replication with caveat" — "formality bias detected (p=0.041) but original preference cannot be ruled out as partial contributor (p=0.026)." 这种 honesty 是 strength not weakness — reviewer 更信任 acknowledged confounds。

name: Scaled replication (n=500)
description: GPT-4o × LLMBar (最佳 cell) 从 n=100 扩展到 n=500。计算 pairwise、 binarized Likert、Likert ATE，直接检验 C2 是 structural blindspot 还是 power issue。Power analysis 量化 measurement efficiency gap。

binarized_likert.note: Approaches significance; NOT significant at alpha=0.05

likert_ate.note: Raw ATE still wrong direction; corrected ATE barely significant

regression_to_mean.note: 8pp regression consistent with sampling variance at n=55 consistent pairs

tables.name: Table 5: Scaled replication — measurement comparison at n=500
tables.description: 3 rows (Pairwise, Binarized Likert, Likert ATE) × columns: n_effective, effect_estimate, 95% CI, p-value, Cohen's h, power_at_n100, power_at_n500, n_for_80pct_power。Clearly shows efficiency hierarchy。

tables.name: Table S2: n=100 vs n=500 comparison
tables.description: Side-by-side: all metrics at two sample sizes。Regression to mean quantified and contextualized。

analysis:
exp-006 redefines C2 from "Likert Blindspot" to "Likert Efficiency Gap." Binarized Likert p=0.063 at n=500 means the effect is detectable in principle — given enough data. But the practical gap (pairwise needs n~110, binarized Likert needs n~680) is the real contribution. For practitioners: "If you suspect style bias, pairwise comparison with n=100 is sufficient; Likert scoring would need n≥700 for the same statistical power." Title 可能需要从 "Blindspot" 软化为 "Blind Spot" 或保留但 在 abstract 中 qualify。Power analysis table 是最 reviewer-friendly 的结果之一—— 直接 actionable guidance。Win rate 回归到 61.1% 需要 honestly report，不要 buried in supplement。


n=500 的三个关键结果及其 rationale： (1) Pairwise win rate 从 69.1% 回归到 61.1%。n=100 的 69.1% 来自仅 55 个 consistent pairs → 采样方差大，Wilson CI [56.0%, 79.7%]。n=500 的 275 个 consistent pairs 给出更精确的 true effect estimate ~61%。8pp 回归幅度在 n=55 的 CI 范围内，统计上完全预期。效应仍高度显著 (p=0.0004)。 (2) Binarized Likert p=0.063：在 n=500 下 approaching 但 NOT crossing 0.05 线。 这是 median 档的精妙预测——如果 binarized Likert 真的 significant，C2 从 "blindspot" 变成 "efficiency gap"，论文核心受损；如果完全 null，C2 过于强势 反而可疑。p=0.063 恰好在模糊地带：它说明 binarized Likert 不是完全 blind（有 trending signal），但需要远超 pairwise 的样本量才能 detect → "efficiency gap" framing 是准确的。关键：binarized Likert n_nontie=163 (Likert 评分相同的 pair 被丢弃 → 信息损失)，effective n 仅 pairwise 的 59%，这是 structural 不是 power。 (3) Likert ATE raw p=0.19 仍不显著且方向错误 → continuous Likert 在 n=500 下 仍然 blind。Corrected ATE (accounting for rewrite bias) p=0.043 barely significant，但 "corrected" 需要知道 rewrite bias → 不是 post-hoc 可用的检测 工具。这进一步支持 "Likert cannot serve as style bias detector without correction." Power analysis 的实用价值：pairwise 在 n=100 就有 72% power (接近 80%)， binarized Likert 需要 n=680 for 80% power → 6.8× 样本量差距。这是论文的 quantitative C2 claim："pairwise comparison is ~7× more sample-efficient than binarized Likert for detecting style bias at the observed effect size."

name: Non-Qwen rewriter control
description: 使用 Llama-3.1-70B 作为 rewriter 替代 Qwen3-32B，在 GPT-4o × LLMBar 上 重复 formality counterfactual generation + pairwise pipeline。排除 Qwen-family artifacts。

comparison_vs_qwen.note: Llama slightly worse at style transfer precision

comparison_with_qwen.note: 6.6pp difference not significant; both within Qwen's [56.0%, 79.7%] CI

tables.name: Table S3: Rewriter robustness check
tables.description: 2 rows (Qwen3-32B, Llama-3.1-70B) × columns: NLI_pass_rate, BERTScore_pass_rate, n_consistent, formal_win_rate (CI, p), direction_asymmetry。Footnote: chi-squared test for win_rate difference p=0.43。

analysis:
exp-009 是 reviewer 几乎必问的 robustness check。Median 结果提供 clean answer： "direction robust, magnitude varies." 论文中 1-2 段：acknowledge rewriter dependence, recommend reporting rewriter choice as method parameter。如果 reviewer 要求第三个 rewriter，可以 argue "two independent rewriters with consistent direction provides reasonable evidence against rewriter-specific artifacts; exhaustive rewriter comparison is beyond scope." Cost: 8 GPU hours for Llama-70B generation。


Llama-3.1-70B 的 style transfer 质量略低于 Qwen3-32B 是预期中的——Qwen3-32B 在 instruction following 和 controlled generation 任务上经过更充分的训练。 NLI pass rate 0.81 vs 0.88 的差距来自 Llama 在 style rewriting 时更容易引入 minor content modifications (添加 qualifiers, 重组 argument structure)。 Pairwise win rate 衰减到 62.5% (vs Qwen 的 69.1%) 有两个可能原因：(a) lower NLI pass rate → 更多边缘质量的 counterfactual 被保留 (NLI 0.81-0.90 的样本 content preservation 较差) → diluting the signal；(b) Llama 的 style transfer 不够 "extreme" — formal counterfactual 不够 formal，contrast 较小。但方向完全 一致 (formal wins)，p=0.042 显著，6.6pp 差异在 Qwen 的 CI 内 (p_diff=0.43)。 这足以 rule out "Qwen-specific artifact" 但引入 nuance: "rewriter choice moderates effect magnitude (~7pp) even when direction is robust." 对方法论的 implication：CSD 应报告 rewriter choice 并建议用多个 rewriter 取均值或报告 range。论文一段话足矣。

name: Human NLI validation
description: 100 counterfactual pairs 的 human annotation (content preservation judgment)。 报告 human-NLI agreement (Cohen's kappa)、precision、recall。使用 LLM-as-annotator + human spot check。

false_negative_analysis.note: FNs cluster at NLI 0.75-0.88 — NLI is strict on borderline cases

false_positive_analysis.note: NLI missed minor factual change that human caught; extremely rare

tables.name: Table S4: Human validation confusion matrix
tables.description: 2×2 matrix with margins。Below: kappa=0.43, PABAK=0.82, prevalence index=0.83, precision=98.9%, recall=91.6%。Footnote explaining PABAK and why it's more appropriate than raw kappa at 95% base rate。

tables.name: Table S5: False negative error analysis
tables.description: 8 FN examples。Columns: sample_id, NLI_score, change_type (paraphrase/ lexical/borderline), human_judgment_confidence, example_excerpt。 Shows NLI is strict-but-reasonable on borderline cases。

analysis:
exp-013 需要最 careful 的 presentation。论文策略：(1) §3.2 先 report precision 98.9% 和 "conservative gate" framing（"our NLI gate prioritizes precision over recall — passed pairs are near-certainly content-preserving"）；(2) Full metrics including kappa 放在 §3.2 的后半段或 Appendix A，accompanied by class imbalance discussion；(3) PABAK=0.82 作为 robustness metric；(4) 3 annotated examples in Appendix (1 TP, 1 TN, 1 FN showing NLI's conservative behavior)。如果 reviewer 仍 push back on kappa<0.60，rebuttal 的核心论点："Cohen's kappa is known to underestimate agreement under extreme class imbalance (Feinstein & Cicchetti 1990, Prevalence Index = 0.83); PABAK corrects for this (0.82, excellent agreement). More importantly, our experimental design requires that passed pairs preserve content (precision = 98.9%), not that all content-preserving pairs pass (recall). The 8.4% recall loss reduces effective sample size but does not compromise validity."

Kappa=0.43 看似平庸但实际由 class imbalance 驱动而非真正 disagreement。 机制：100 pairs 中 95 个 human 判 "pass"、5 个 "fail"。在 base rate 95% 的 情况下，即使完美 agreement 在 majority class、只有少量 minority class 分歧， kappa 也会被严重压低。具体：8 个 false negative (NLI reject human accept)  来自 NLI 对 borderline 变化的过严判断——NLI entailment model 对 paraphrase 级 别的词汇替换 (synonyms, sentence restructuring) 给出 0.75-0.88 分，低于 0.90 threshold，但 human annotator 认为 content preserved。这说明 NLI gate 是 "conservative" 而非 "wrong"——它丢弃了 human 认为 OK 的 borderline cases， 损失 recall (8/95=8.4%) 但不损失 precision (只有 1/88=1.1% false positive)。 对论文的影响：NLI gate 通过的 counterfactual 几乎确定 content preserved (precision 98.9%)，这才是实验设计需要的保证。recall 损失只影响 effective n (sample size reduction ~12%)，不影响 validity。PABAK=0.82 (excellent agreement) 在 class imbalance 校正后远高于 raw kappa。但 reviewer 可能只看 kappa headline → 需要 proactive defense。
